scheduledPipelines.title: Daily job search
scheduledPipelines.lastRunNote: 1 match (Tier 1) — Amazon Ring ACD, Hawthorne CA

recommendations: Your Indeed results aren't time-filtered — the Amazon Ring ACD that surfaced was posted February 28, nearly 4 months ago. Adding a "past 14 days" filter to Indeed searches would cut stale noise significantly.
The LinkedIn 24h window is great for freshness, but roles posted late Friday or over the weekend can slip through before the 4am run on Monday. Consider widening to 72h on Mondays only.

"CRM Creative Director" is a very niche title that almost never appears as a standalone posting — it's usually buried inside broader creative or marketing roles. Dropping it from search strings could tighten results without losing real matches.

Adding "Head of Design" and "VP of Creative" to stretch-level searches would surface more tech-company roles where those titles replace "Creative Director" — especially at mid-stage startups that pay ACD+ comp.

You're only searching LinkedIn and Indeed. Wellfound (AngelList) tends to surface earlier-stage startup roles where your broad skillset — brand, product, AI — is a genuine differentiator. Worth adding as a third source.

The remote search strings are long OR chains. When too many titles are ORed together, the algorithm can dilute ranking quality. Consider splitting into two focused searches: one for brand/campaign titles (ACD, CD, Brand Director) and one for product-adjacent titles (Product Design Lead, Head of Design).

No search currently targets agencies directly. Given your agency background, a dedicated search like "Creative Director" at agency/studio companies — or using the "Creative agency" industry filter on LinkedIn — could surface roles that are a natural home for your art direction roots.

Most of your Tier 1–2 matches skew fintech and consumer tech. If you're open to entertainment or streaming, adding "Associate Creative Director" with an industry filter for Media & Entertainment could open up a strong LA-specific lane (Netflix, Disney+, etc.).
